headwords: thiên thượng thiên hạ, bác ái công bình
thiên thời, địa lợi, nhân hoà

flags.why: Thiên tạo means naturally formed, not the noun ‘nature’, as recorded in [the dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/thi%C3%AAn_t%E1%BA%A1o).
The gloss ‘solitary’ loses the sense of being forlorn and in difficulty or danger recorded in [the dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-thon%20von).
flags.fix: forlorn; in a difficult or precarious situation

flags.why: Thon von describes a forlorn or precarious condition, not a building standing alone, as shown by [the dictionary example](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-thon%20von).
flags.fix: Bơ vơ đất khách thon von nỗi này. = Alone in a foreign land, in this forlorn predicament.
